svg.title: VisionIQ 05 - DEFECT deep path, red-green verification
svg.text: DEFECT — Fix to PR with Red-Green Proof
Queued after the brief. Every stop is visible on the ticket; nothing is reported green that did not run green.
• From the evidence bundle; keep alternatives and contradicting
• Baseline SHA + runner image digest; write ExecutionManifest
• From the ticket, existing tests and verified history
Run the test on the unchanged baseline
• Isolated runner, no secrets, restricted egress
• In the right layer; Claude as first coding candidate
• Plus touched-path performance, repeated paired runs
• Defect → cause → risk → fix, SHAs, test IDs, logs
Native CI + branch policy on the PR
• Published as PR checks; failing or NOT_RUN never green
• Escalate with the reason on the
• Back to step 5. Budget spent: show
Test outcomes: PASS · FAIL_TARGET_SIGNATURE · FAIL_DIFFERENT_SIGNATURE · FLAKY · ENVIRONMENT_ERROR · TIMEOUT · NOT_RUN · UNAVAILABLE · INCONCLUSIVE
